idle: Ready to dictate, including offline. No audio is being captured.
recording: The microphone is capturing your take. A solid dot accompanies the color.
busy: Opening a device, loading the model, or transcribing. The tooltip gives the exact status.
error: Microphone, engine, transcription, or delivery failure. Read the status message for details.

default: Dictation header and stopped microphone checks.
listening: Microphone check after the device opens.
thinking: Help header, opening a microphone, or very little audio detected.
success: Audio detected during the microphone check.
error: Microphone check failed; the message explains why.
speaking: Voice commands page: guidance for speaking commands. Does not indicate speech output.
typing: Vocabulary page: names, phrases, and text cleanup. Does not confirm text delivery.

alpha: PNG files are RGBA. Badge fills and the speech balloon interior are intentional. Cutout marks and mascots have transparent backgrounds.
usage: Choose for-light cutouts on light backgrounds and for-dark on dark backgrounds. Use inverse white marks and wordmark on dark backgrounds. Preview all assets in Help > Icons & artwork. Offline is Ready; speaking and typing mascots are illustrations, not app capabilities.
